  • Decisions (ADRs)
    • 0001 — The docs site is public, with a publication boundary
    • 0002 — Mirror the access logs unfiltered; interpret with views
    • 0003 — Request logging after the Cloudflare cutover
    • 0004 — Download statistics are generated static files, not a live service
    • 0005 — Completeness is measured by origin, not by page type
    • 0006 — 33 of 35 releases, and checkResults for them, are archival
    • 0007 — Cloudflare Workflows carries the human-approval gate, starting with the release roll
    • 0008 — Split by audience into three repositories; migrate by strangling behind the Worker
    • 0009 — Client addresses are hashed at the edge, not de-identified downstream
    • 0010 — Two new repos for the parallel build system; the governance file is the manifest, not a registry
    • 0011 — One propagation gate for every producer
    • 0012 — Client addresses are stored raw; de-identification is a view
    • 0013 — A redirect lands on the content, or it goes

CI & Scheduled Jobs

Every GitHub Actions workflow in the public bioc repos, what it tests, how they relate, and whether it is green right now

One page for the question “what is red, and does it matter?” Status badges are live. The table under Workflows is generated at site build by ci-inventory.py from the GitHub API, so it matches the workflows in each repo; the description column is each workflow’s leading comment block, so a workflow with no header comment shows only its name. Everything else on this page is hand-written.

How the new-system workflows relate

The r-universe components are not ours and have no badge on this page. A stalled r-universe shows up here as freshness red on “latest observation under 36 hours”, since the registry polls its API and nothing else changes when r-universe stops. bioc-build’s build.yml is a pinned verbatim copy of r-universe’s, so the two build boxes run the same engine. bioc-manifest does not trigger bioc-build: bioc-build’s dispatch.yml is workflow_dispatch only, and its schedule is deferred until the registry publisher is proven.

This diagram shows the new-system checks, not the production publishing path. bioconductor.org’s packages are still built by BBS (source tarballs) and mostly r-universe (binaries), and reach R2 through the hourly bioc-sync from master.bioconductor.org. The registry path above publishes only at the registry’s own host; switching to it is the registry switch plan. The production path is on how bioconductor.org works.

Reading a red badge:

  • publish red: the bioc-build → registry ingest broke. Experimental path; software packages from r-universe are unaffected.
  • freshness red, publish green: the Worker is down, the observer stalled, or the served index is inconsistent (the #34 invariant).
  • install red, freshness green: what the registry serves does not install. Since #47 the canary runs in the r-universe build image, so this is no longer “the runner lacks a system library”.
  • health or parity red: the served site, not the data plane. Health probes bioconductor.org (since 2026-09-29). Parity compares bioconductor.org with master.bioconductor.org path by path; the known differences are tracked in bioc-edge #43 to #46.
  • links red: link rot on the served site, a content problem.

Scheduled jobs outside GitHub Actions

The systemd --user timers on onclappc02, following the platform scheduling convention. All of them run on that one host, mostly from development checkouts of their repos (bioc-site-refresh uses its own clone of main) (for example ~/Documents/git/bioc-edge); moving them to separate operations checkouts is planned in bioc-infrastructure#43. There is no live status column: these alert on failure only (a GitHub issue or an ntfy push), and the heartbeat that would prove “ran OK today” is not set up yet.

Unit Repo Cadence What it does On failure
bioc-sync bioc-edge hourly rsync from master.bioconductor.org to the local mirror, upload changes to R2, purge them from the edge cache, regenerate the mirror manifest GitHub issue
bioc-site-refresh bioc-website every 20 min When Bioconductor/bioconductor.org devel moves: regenerate prose and assets into the site data snapshot, upload it, dispatch the site build. Keeps replaced snapshots in /data/davsean/bioc-site-refresh/snapshots GitHub issue
bioc-reconcile bioc-edge weekly, Sun 04:00 Checksum drift check: does R2 match the local mirror GitHub issue
bioc-logpush-check bioc-edge daily 07:15 Alert if yesterday’s Logpush access-log delivery to GCS is missing GitHub issue
biocintel-refresh bioc-intelligence monthly, 1st 06:00 UTC Enrichment pipeline: extract → link → enrich → marts → publish ntfy

Private repos with timers are not listed.

Workflows

The repos that make up the new system and its platform services, active workflows only. Dynamic workflows GitHub injects (Pages deploy, Copilot) are excluded; which repos appear is the GROUPS map in the script.

Experimental

Prototypes of a standalone build path for the packages r-universe does not build (data-experiment, annotation, workflows; ADR 0010). Not the production route: software packages reach the registry from r-universe. A red badge here is not a production incident.
